title: 上方保护精准一步
description: 钢笔淡彩强调准确踏点与完整绳路，保护者的制动位置毫不含糊。

art_direction.medium: soft pastel drawing with clear contour accents
art_direction.scene: An original pen-and-wash illustration shows a fictional fully clothed adult carefully placing a shoe on a positive foothold of an indoor top-rope route. Both hands hold generous amber jugs and the other foot remains engaged. A wide oblique view includes the adult's correctly fitted harness, proper rope tie-in through designated points, continuous rope up to the overhead anchor and back down to a competent harnessed adult belayer. The belayer watches the climber with the brake hand down on the brake strand beside the device. Use fine blue contours, warm ochre washes, clear floor, and plausible contacts. No free solo, tangled rope, captions, brands, or dynamic leap.
